title: TextCNN reaction type score guides chemoenzymatic synthesis planning
summary: RTS-CESP uses a TextCNN-based reaction type score to rank retrosynthesis routes and choose steps replaceable by enzymatic reactions. It predicted all 10 literature chemoenzymatic routes (six top-ranked) and routes for 554 of 1000 molecules, outperforming ASKCOS, and a shorter route for the drug Alclofenac was experimentally validated. Yields were not read.
